limitations.note: The patch clocked only the shift register and left `data` combinational, so after each rising edge `data` reflects the newly rotated `q[5]` rather than capturing its pre-edge value.

limitations.quote: A rising edge with `rst_n` low reloads `001011`
limitations.note: The patch made the shift register's reset synchronous, so a reset pulse entirely between rising edges no longer restarts the sequence.
The test counted the sample before the first post-reset rising edge as bit zero and held reset across a rising edge, masking both the output phase error and the missing asynchronous reset.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The first simulation command was rejected because of its cleanup command, so the agent had to submit the test again with a different cleanup method.
